mechanism: Ceftazidime contains a methylthiotetrazole (MTT) side chain that can inhibit vitamin K-dependent clotting factor synthesis and displace protein-bound drugs, while disulfiram may potentiate these effects through hepatic enzyme inhibition and chelation properties.
action: Monitor for signs of bleeding; consider alternative antibiotic if prolonged cephalosporin therapy needed; assess INR/PT if patient on concurrent anticoagulants; ensure adequate vitamin K intake.
